content:
Here is a formalized proof of a conjecture on "mixed partition functions" which has bothered for me a while. I fed Fable my stream-of-consciousness notes and made the suggestion that Deligne's theorem on tensor categories might help; it did the rest, modulo some shouting at it not to be lazy. Cross-checking was done by GPT Pro, and the formalization was done by Fable and Opus 5.

I hope someone finds it interesting. I tried to follow the community conventions here and created formalization.yaml and as small a surface as possible for Challenge.lean.

I've now updated this to include (auto-)formalized code for Deligne's theorem (in fibre-functor form), which as far as I can tell has never been formalized in any proof assistant before now. This makes the paper's results completely assumption free in the repo.
Challenge.lean is now completely self-contained (bar mathlib) and the repo has been registered on Palomar.
